title: recommendation
description: The Orchestrator agent's final output: an advisory keep-or-rebalance call synthesized from the analytic + strategic metrics and the Strategic agent's assessment, grounded by the RAG knowledge corpus. It is never executed automatically — the owner decides.

summary.description: A few sentences: portfolio health, the main risk, and the headline call.

fragility_read.description: One-line plain-language read of the anti-fragility posture (fragile/robust/antifragile and why).

actions.description: Concrete, advisory adjustments (empty when verdict = keep).

symbol.description: Ticker, or 'CASH' / an asset-class name for sleeve-level moves.

size.description: Optional magnitude, e.g. '-2% weight' or '+0.5% to short bonds'.

grounded_refs.description: Knowledge-corpus snippets the recommendation leaned on.
